title: I LOVE MYSELF
note: Re-release with binaural beats (DreamForge: left 285 Hz / right 294 Hz, 9 Hz beat, 18 LU under the song) and the new covers. Full cut (3:32) for YouTube; under-3:00 cut (2:59) for the Short, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, since Reels over 3 minutes aren't shown to non-followers. LinkedIn comes later.
alt_text: A gold frequency ring pulses around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold. The lyrics appear one line at a time: I love myself. I love the way I feel in my own skin. At the drop, a gold shockwave rolls outward and the veins light up from the emblem. It ends on I LOVE MYSELF, NDCH FREQ 001.

location.name: Temple of Apollo, Delphi
location.why: Carved at the entrance: Know thyself. You can't love what you won't look at, and FREQ starts there.
